title: crataegus oxyacantha var. microphylla
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha var. microphylla, commonly known as the dwarf hawthorn, is a small deciduous shrub that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The dwarf hawthorn is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health due to its vasodilatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include acting as a cardiotonic, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of the dwarf hawthorn include flavonoids, such as quercetin and epicatechin, as well as other compounds like oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs) and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
